## Features
- Embrace the festive period
- Children are sure to love it
- Easy to place in the ground

## Information
Give your house that festive feel this year with the brilliant Santa Stop Here Banner Stake. Ensure that jolly St. Nick knows to stop at your house with this fantastic decoration. With an easy to place stake you will be able to place this amazing decoration in your front garden, in a plant pot or simply propped up in your house. It also features an ever so cheerful Santa holding the ?Santa Stop? sign that is sure to get the attention of the man in the red coat. Simply places this colourful sign in the perfect place and make sure that Father Christmas can see your house this Christmas.
